result:
I’d make a safe childhood universal.

Not a perfect childhood, or one without sadness—but one with enough food, a safe place to sleep, and someone dependable who cares. Safety wouldn’t depend on where you were born or whether the adults around you happened to be capable of providing it.

It wouldn’t fix everything. But fewer people would have to spend their lives recovering from the beginning of them.
